```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
# QC filter
# Get filter summaries
filter_summary_files <- dir(
  "qc_filter",
  pattern = ".*\\.hard_filter_summary\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
filter_summaries <- lapply(filter_summary_files, function(f) {
  read_csv(f)
})
filter_summary <- bind_rows(filter_summaries) %>%
  mutate(prop_filtered = prop_filtered * 100) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

# Get sample names and map them to directory names
samples <- sapply(filter_summary_files, function(s) {
  gsub("^qc_filter\\/.*\\/(.*)\\.hard_filter_summary\\.csv$", "\\1", s)
})
names(samples) <- sapply(names(samples), function(s) {
  gsub("^qc_filter\\/(.*)\\/.*$", "\\1", s)
})
sample_map <- setNames(names(samples), samples)

# Get count distribution graphs
cdist_log_graph_files <- sapply(sample_map, function(i) {
  s <- samples[[i]]
  paste("qc_filter", i, paste(s, "count_distributions.log.png", sep = "."), sep = "/")
})
cdist_graph_files <- sapply(sample_map, function(i) {
  s <- samples[[i]]
  paste("qc_filter", i, paste(s, "count_distributions.png", sep = "."), sep = "/")
})

# Get pre- and post-filtering plots
pre_filter_plots <- sapply(sample_map, function(i) {
  s <- samples[[i]]
  paste("qc_filter", i, paste(s, "feature_count_plot.pre_filtered.png", sep = "."), sep = "/")
})
post_filter_plots <- sapply(sample_map, function(i) {
  s <- samples[[i]]
  paste("qc_filter", i, paste(s, "feature_count_plot.post_filtered.png", sep = "."), sep = "/")
})
```

:::panel-tabset

```{r}
#| results: asis
# Display count distribution plots
purrr::walk(
  sort(samples),
  function(n) {
    p <- cdist_graph_files[[n]]
    p_log <- cdist_log_graph_files[[n]]
    f_pre <- pre_filter_plots[[n]]
    f_post <- post_filter_plots[[n]]
    cat(paste("###", n, "\n\n"))
    cat(paste("####", "Count distributions", "\n\n"))
    cat(paste0('<img src="', p, '" alt="count distribution plot: ', n, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
    cat(paste0('<img src="', p_log, '" alt="log-count distribution plot: ', n, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
    cat(paste("####", "Features vs counts - pre-filter", "\n\n"))
    cat(paste0('<img src="', f_pre, '" alt="pre-filter plot: ', n, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
    cat(paste("####", "Features vs counts - post-filter", "\n\n"))
    cat(paste0('<img src="', f_post, '" alt="post-filter plot: ', n, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
  }
)
```
